title: Self-Diagnosis in the Digital Age
shared_passage:
Watch a video about cyberchondria. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.

Cyberchondriac is a new term some of the medical community are using for people who self-diagnose their medical ailments.

DOCTOR HILDEN: I think people do tend to think they are sicker than they are based on the searches that they've done.

DOCTOR HILDEN: I hadn't heard the term cyberchondria until very recently.

NARRATOR: He says cyberchondria is becoming more prevalent and leads to unnecessary patient anxiety, and requests for tests that are not really needed.

DOCTOR HILDEN: I spend a considerable amount of time reassuring people that what they have is not as dangerous as they think. Overall, I think their effect is probably beneficial, in so far as it does educate people as to what symptoms they should be concerned with.

NARRATOR: Hilden says the Internet is a great resource when it comes to preventive care too, like providing information about cholesterol, cardiovascular health or quitting smoking.
